rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of --saveExact option when saving dependencies in Project.install
rawFindings.explanation: The modified Project.install method now treats --saveExact differently from --save and --saveDev regarding how the dependency version is saved into bower.json. However, the new code incorrectly adds the dependency with the source URL plus '#' plus version, only when saveExact is set, and only adds it to dependencies when save is set. This means if only --saveExact is specified (without save or saveDev), the new entry is not saved to either dependencies or devDependencies, and thus is omitted fro
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the logic to ensure that if --saveExact is set, the dependency string is properly saved to dependencies or devDependencies depending on the presence of --save or --saveDev, and when both save and saveDev are false but saveExact is true, still add it sensibly (likely to dependencies).
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Running 'bower install package --save-exact' without --save or --save-dev does not add the package to bower.json dependencies or devDependencies, causing the package not to be saved as expected.
